name: Glutathione
description: Tripeptide (three amino acids) made by the body; acts as an antioxidant in cells

items.label: Parkinson's disease
items.detail: IV and nasal; no gain vs placebo

note.lead: Not tested for aging in people.
note.text: No study has tested injected or nasal glutathione for aging or longevity in people.

bullets: **Antioxidant** made by the body that helps protect cells from oxidative stress
Its antioxidant role is established in **cell and animal** biology
**In people,** effects of injected or nasal glutathione on aging are not studied
Nasal Phase IIb: not better than placebo

practical.monitored: Disease scores, adverse events, blood chemistry
practical.sport: Not on the 2026 list; IV over 100 mL per 12 h prohibited (M2.2)

references: J Parkinsons Dis, nasal glutathione Phase IIb trial in Parkinson's, 2017
FDA, reminder not to use supplement-grade glutathione for injectables, Aug 2026
